intro: The Bijou Picture Palace closed its doors many years ago.

But every night, Elias the projectionist came back...
and ran the pictures for an empty house.
One night, he didn't come back.
His old pocket watch stayed behind in the projection booth...
...and stopped at one minute to midnight.
previously: Tick woke up alone in an empty picture palace, stopped at 11:59.

endCards: Old Smokestack got his ending at last.
Somewhere in the lost and found, a music box began to play...
Miss Pirouette got her ending at last.
For the first time in fifty years, she leaves the lid of her music box open.
